title: Data centre critical power loss
goal: Show quantified failure logic for redundant UPS modules and upstream electrical sources.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Critical IT load de-energised is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows two UPS module failures at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates utility feeder and standby generator failures.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.
